publicSignals.text: Anonymized case studies - service vertical, region, call volume, close rate, monthly revenue.
The case studies below are representative, anonymized examples of how the model works.
Close rate jumped from ~12% to ~38% because calls came from the contractor's own website instead of a shared marketplace where the homeowner had already been quoted by 4 competitors.

3.5× CALL VOLUME 38% CLOSE RATE $1.2K MONTHLY RENT ~$22K NEW MONTHLY REVENUE CASE 02 · SIMI VALLEY ADU ADU + garage conversion builder, Ventura County Setup Two-crew ADU specialist working Simi Valley, Moorpark, and Camarillo.
Lead source was 80% referral, 20% Yelp paid - capacity to take 2 more new builds per quarter.
A $300 exclusive lead that closes at 40% costs you $750 per closed job.
A $40 shared lead that closes at 10% costs you $400 per closed job - but only if you actually answer faster than the other four contractors in the marketplace.
Storm-damage cycles drive temporary spikes - if a major storm hits a market, expect lead prices to climb 20-40% for 60-90 days.
Close rates are extremely high (60%+) because the homeowner has no time to shop.
Adds 50-200% to per-lead pricing vs shared marketplaces.
Bottom line # Pay close to the high end of the range for verticals where the underlying job is worth $20K+ and your close rate on exclusive leads is above 30%.
A $40 lead that closes 1 in 10 costs you $400 per job in lead spend.
A $200 lead that closes 4 in 10 costs you $500 per job - but you booked four jobs instead of one, with a quarter of the phone time and follow-up.
Referrals and repeat customers # Close rate: ~50%.
Make them systematic: ask every satisfied customer for a review and a referral, send a follow-up text a week after the job, and keep a simple list of past customers to remarket to seasonally.

WHY CONTRACTORS CHOOSE US What makes our leads different 01 Exclusive territory One contractor per market.

View all insights → WHAT WE DO Exclusive leads for contractors, not a shared marketplace Most lead companies sell the same lead to four or five contractors at once, then let you fight over it on price.
That is what exclusive contractor leads actually means: no bidding, no shared lists, no racing a competitor to call the homeowner back.

Because you are the only contractor on the line and the homeowner has an active need, exclusive leads convert far better than shared marketplace leads - typically 30 to 45 percent versus 8 to 15 percent on platforms like Angi, HomeAdvisor, and Thumbtack.
An exclusive lead can cost more per call and still cost far less per closed job, because you close so many more of them.

We run exclusive lead generation for eleven home-service verticals across California - roofing, HVAC, ADU, EV charger, electrician, plumbing, solar and battery, epoxy floor, garage door, pest control, and restoration - with two simple pricing options: flat monthly for a locked territory, or pay-per-lead so you only pay when the phone rings.

Our leads are exclusive: you are the only contractor the homeowner reaches, so close rates run 30 to 45 percent.
